h: King CND criticises Burna Boy over reconciliation with Davido, citing VeryDarkMan
p: Content creator King CND has reportedly accused Burna Boy of betraying VeryDarkMan after the singer made peace with Davido. His remarks have drawn mixed reactions from fans online.
more: King CND says the reconciliation undermined VeryDarkMan.
Fans of both singers have reacted online.
